'''''Carex acutiformis''''', the '''lesser pond-sedge''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> is a species of plant in the ''Carex'', or [[Carex|sedge]] family.

==Description==
Carex acutiformis is a tuft-forming, rhizomatous plant growing up to {{convert|150|cm}} tall. Stems are slender and three angled. Leaves are narrow, with a tendency to droop at the tips, and measuring up to {{convert|160|cm|abbr=on}} long and {{convert|5|-|20|mm|1|abbr=on}} wide. Inflorescence consists of 2 to 3 male and 3 to 4 female spikelets. Male spikelets measure 1 to 4 cm, and are generally purple-brown in colour. Female spikelets measure between 2 and 5 cm, and are cylindrical in shape, erect and short-stalked.<ref>{{cite book |author1=A. Clive Jermy |author2=David A. Simpson |author3=Michael J. Y. Foley |author4=Michael S. Porter |year=2007 |title=Sedges of the British ISles |series=BSBI Handbook no. 1 |edition=3rd |publisher=[[Botanical Society of the British Isles]] |isbn=978-0-901158-35-2 |pages=295–297 |chapter=''Carex acutiformis''}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Lesser Pond-sedge {{!}} NatureSpot |url=https://www.naturespot.org/species/lesser-pond-sedge |access-date=2025-02-25 |website=www.naturespot.org}}</ref>

==Ecology==
It is native to parts of northern and western [[Europe]] , where it grows in moist spots in a number of habitat types. In its native European range this species is often associated with the [[Juncus subnodulosus-Cirsium palustre fen-meadow|''Juncus subnodulosus''–''Cirsium palustre'' fen-meadow]] [[habitat]].<ref>{{cite web |author=C. Michael Hogan |date=October 12, 2009 |accessdate=August 3, 2010 |url=http://www.globaltwitcher.com/artspec_information.asp?thingid=48639 |title=Marsh Thistle: ''Cirsium palustre'' |publisher=GlobalTwitcher.com |editor=N. Strömberg |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20121213144520/http://www.globaltwitcher.com/artspec_information.asp?thingid=48639 |archivedate=December 13, 2012 }}</ref> It is also a dominant plant in the ''Carex acutiformis'' swamp [[plant association]].<ref>{{cite book |editor=John S. Rodwell |series=British Plant Communities, Volume 4 |title=Aquatic communities, swamps and tall-herb fens |page=160 |year=1998 |isbn=978-0-521-62718-4}}</ref>
